name: Light of My Life
source:
A story of love, light, bizarre innuendos, and sentences never before put to paper. Follow our hero, Sol, as he grasps with the struggles and challenges of being a celestial body! Fend off stalkers! Satisfy unpleasable roommates! Get your sunpai to finally notice you! All of these and more are possible in Light Of My Life!

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=24358&sid=a6f842c054b440794daba46db7591b72]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
translation:
一个关于爱、光明、离奇的暗示和从未写在纸上的句子的故事。跟随我们的英雄索尔，了解他如何应对成为天体的斗争和挑战！抵御跟踪狂！满足不愉快的室友！让你的太阳终于注意到你了！所有这些以及更多在《我的生活之光》中都是可能的！
